|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are its release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image. The later errata version is [[Ket Maliss, Shadow Killer (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of May 11, 2012"; this copy was re-made on 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with opponent's character of ability > 2, Ket Maliss is power +1, defense value +2, and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Whenever an opponent's character is lost from same site, opponent loses 1 Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Ket_Maliss_Shadow_Killer.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-ketmalissshadowkiller-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ket Maliss, Shadow Killer (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) has “power +1 and defense value + 2 and draws” instead of “power +1, defense value +2, and draws” and “Whenever opponent's character was lost” instead of “Whenever an opponent's character is lost” (the pilot icon written out as “Adds two to the power of anything he pilots.”)<ref name="cl-1281_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Adds two to the power of anything he pilots. While with opponent's character of ability > 2, Ket Maliss is power +1 and defense value + 2 and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Whenever opponent's character was lost from same site, opponent loses 1 Force.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Ket_Maliss_Shadow_Killer-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
